# Plan: Multi-Page Streamlit App with Market Intelligence

Transform dice-llm into a comprehensive multi-page Streamlit application with 5 distinct features: job search, market intelligence, search history, profile comparison, and settings - restructuring [app.py](src/app.py) into modular pages while adding profile-independent market analysis with batch processing for token efficiency, dual visualization libraries (Plotly/Altair) with UI toggle, and privacy-first defaults (24-hour data retention with opt-in for longer storage).

## Steps

1. **Restructure project for multi-page architecture** - Create `Home.py` landing page with feature cards, move [app.py](src/app.py) to `pages/1_🎯_Job_Search.py`, add page stubs for Market Intelligence, History, Profile Comparison, Settings, create `src/ui/` directory with [components.py](src/ui/components.py) and [charts.py](src/ui/charts.py), update [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml) dependencies adding `plotly>=5.18.0` and `altair>=5.2.0`

2. **Implement batch analysis infrastructure** - Add `batch_analyze_jobs()` to [prompts.py](src/core/prompts.py) accepting 50-100 jobs and returning aggregated stats in single Claude call (saving ~90% tokens vs individual scoring), add `BATCH_MARKET_ANALYSIS_PROMPT` processing JSON array of job summaries (titles, descriptions, salaries) into skill counts and salary ranges, update [llm.py](integrations/llm.py) with `batch_analyze_market()` method setting `max_tokens=4096`

3. **Enhance MCP client for pagination and bulk fetching** - Add `bulk_search_jobs()` async method to [mcp_client.py](src/integrations/mcp_client.py) fetching multiple pages (up to 500 jobs) with configurable `jobs_per_query` and `delay_between_queries=2.0` for rate limiting, update `_execute_with_retry()` to support page iteration, add `estimate_total_results()` helper using meta pagination data from MCP responses

4. **Create Market Intelligence core module** - Add [market.py](src/core/market.py) with `fetch_market_snapshot()` (bulk fetch + batch analysis), `aggregate_skills()` (count/rank skills from job array), `normalize_salaries()` (parse strings to min/max/currency dicts), `cache_snapshot()` and `load_cached_snapshot()` with configurable TTL defaulting to 24 hours, extend [schemas.py](src/core/schemas.py) with `MarketQuery`, `JobTrend`, `MarketSnapshot`, `SkillFrequency`, `StorageSettings` models

5. **Build visualization library with dual-engine support** - Create [charts.py](src/ui/charts.py) with `create_skill_chart()`, `create_salary_boxplot()`, `create_workplace_distribution()`, `create_trend_timeseries()` - each function accepting `engine: Literal["plotly", "altair"]` parameter, implement Plotly versions with `plotly.express` (interactive hover, zoom, export), implement Altair versions with `alt.Chart()` (declarative, static), add `render_chart_with_toggle()` wrapper storing preference in `st.session_state.chart_engine`

6. **Implement Market Intelligence page** - Create `pages/2_📊_Market_Intelligence.py` with keyword textarea (comma-separated, no profile needed), constraint multiselects (workplace types, employment types, date range), analyze button triggering `fetch_market_snapshot()`, results section displaying total jobs metric, top skills bar chart, salary distribution boxplot, workplace pie chart, geographic heatmap, AI insights expander, export CSV button saving to downloads, chart engine toggle in sidebar, notice about 24-hour default retention with link to Settings

7. **Create Search History viewer** - Add `pages/3_📜_Search_History.py` reading `~/.job-scout/searches/` directory (searches organized by month), display table with columns (timestamp, queries, total results, top score, constraints), filters for date range and min score threshold, clickable rows expanding full search details (queries used, job matches with scores), "Rerun Search" button loading constraints/queries back to Job Search page, delete individual searches functionality, show retention policy status

8. **Implement Profile Comparison with auto-versioning** - Create `pages/4_📊_Profile_Comparison.py` storing last 10 profile versions automatically in `~/.job-scout/profile/history/` with timestamp-based filenames, upload new resume/LinkedIn triggering `process_resume()` and `archive_current_profile()` managing rotation (delete oldest when count exceeds 10), display two-column comparison showing Current (most recent) vs Selected Version dropdown (choose from 10 archived versions), skill additions/removals with color coding (green=added, red=removed), experience/title changes diff, keyword density comparison, "Resume Evolution" timeline chart showing skill count over time

9. **Build lightweight Settings page with privacy-first defaults** - Add `pages/5_⚙️_Settings.py` with API key management (Anthropic key stored in plaintext .env for simplicity), data directory path configuration (default `~/.job-scout/`), **Data Retention** section with "Privacy Mode" toggle (ON by default: 24hr cache, OFF: opt-in to longer retention), when Privacy Mode disabled show advanced controls (market snapshot TTL: 24/48/72 hours or 7/30 days, search history retention: 7/30/60/90 days, max market snapshots: 10/25/50/100), storage usage bar chart with breakdown (profiles: X MB, searches: Y MB, market: Z MB), yellow warning at 500MB, red warning at 900MB, auto-cleanup at 1GB (deletes oldest files, no user confirmation needed), "Export All Data" button creating timestamped ZIP backup, "Clear Category Data" buttons with confirmation dialogs, visualization preferences (default chart engine, color scheme)

10. **Add comprehensive state management** - Create [state.py](src/core/state.py) with `AppState` class containing `init_job_search()`, `init_market_intel()`, `init_history()`, `init_profile_comparison()`, `init_settings()` methods initializing default `StorageSettings(privacy_mode=True, cache_ttl=24, auto_cleanup=True, cleanup_threshold_mb=1024)`, namespace all session state into page-specific dicts preventing collisions, add `get_shared_clients()` returning singleton MCP/Claude clients, add `load_settings()` to apply user-configured retention policies, implement `persist_state()` and `restore_state()` for cross-page navigation

11. **Create persistent data structure with lightweight retention** - Update storage to `~/.job-scout/profile/` (profile.json, linkedin.json, history/), `~/.job-scout/searches/` (organized by month: `2026-01.jsonl`), `~/.job-scout/market/` (snapshots.jsonl, trends_cache.json), `~/.job-scout/settings/` (config.json with default `privacy_mode: true`), add [storage.py](src/core/storage.py) module with `enforce_retention_policies()` checking settings and pruning data older than cache_ttl when privacy_mode enabled, `calculate_storage_usage()` returning dict of sizes per category, `auto_cleanup_if_needed()` called on startup automatically deleting oldest data if total exceeds 1GB, `export_all_data()` creating ZIP with manifest, implement profile rotation in [resume.py](src/core/resume.py) with `archive_current_profile()` managing 10-version limit

12. **Extract reusable UI components** - Create [components.py](src/ui/components.py) with `render_profile_status()` (name, dates, edit button), `render_constraints_form()` (all filters with state binding), `render_job_card()` (expander with scores/skills), `render_score_breakdown()` (5 progress bars), `render_filter_sidebar()` (shared across pages), `render_page_header()` (title with icon and description), `render_storage_warning()` (displays yellow alert at 500MB, red alert at 900MB with cleanup info), `render_privacy_notice()` (explains 24hr default retention), ensure components accept namespace parameter for state isolation

## Further Considerations

1. **Git-based resume workflow integration** - After current implementation is stable, add Git integration feature enabling branch/commit comparison for A/B testing multiple resume versions, track performance metrics per variant (response rates, interview conversions based on job search results), automated comparison reports via CI/CD pipeline hooks - revisit in future iteration.

2. **Multi-board integration with pluggable architecture** - After core features are stable, refactor [mcp_client.py](src/integrations/mcp_client.py) to abstract base `JobBoardClient` class with pluggable adapters for Dice (existing), LinkedIn Jobs, Indeed, and other tech-focused job boards with open MCP servers, add board selector multiselect in UI, implement independent caching per source, generate cross-board market intelligence - revisit in future iteration.
